name: System Party Identification 2 Choice
definition: Choice between an identification of a party or a combination of the responsible party identification and the business identifier.

OrganisationIdentification.name: Organisation Identification

CombinedIdentification.name: Combined Identification
CombinedIdentification.definition: Identifies the party with the combined identification of both the responsible entity and the party itself.
